parsed.reason: Description A says the broad except Exception around parse_row misclassifies programming errors as row rejections. Description B says the try also wraps the batch flush, so sink failures are treated as malformed rows and a batch is silently dropped. Both point at line 67's broad except, but A's failure is bugs being reported as bad data, while B's is sink/flush errors causing silent data loss. These are different failure mechanisms.
